name: Public source job run record
description: A durable audit row for a queued object-factory job, including job id, input hash, expected row families, output pointers, policy summary, worker image, and dry-run status.
publication_rule: Do not inline source bodies or private source material.

name: Public source job checkpoint
description: A resumable checkpoint keyed by job id and full job payload hash so unchanged jobs can be skipped and changed jobs can be re-emitted additively.
publication_rule: Store ids, hashes, and output paths only.

name: Public source partition manifest
description: Partition metadata grouped by expected row family for source records, normalized objects, entity refs, dedupe clusters, index records, embeddings, labels, dimensions, and review tickets.
publication_rule: Reference generated JSONL shards by path and content hash.

name: Dry-run output pointer
description: An object-storage pointer reserved for a later real worker output so the queue, Postgres bulk loader, and replay registry can be tested before scraping begins.
publication_rule: Pointer must not imply that source content has been captured or licensed.

name: Additive rerun rule
description: If a job id is already checkpointed with the same payload hash, skip it; if the payload hash changes, emit a new run record without deleting old partitions.
publication_rule: Preserve older run records for audit and comparison.
